title: NexTrial RBQM Risk Taxonomy
description: Named, versioned risk taxonomy assigned by the RBQM pre-gate and frozen into Property 5 of the proof certificate. Rows are taken from the framework paper (regulatory-validation-framework-v3.md) §4.3 only. This document is both the taxonomy of record and a JSON Schema resource: $defs.riskClass is referenced by $ref from proof-certificate.schema.json.

riskClass.title: Risk class
riskClass.description: The four risk classes of the RBQM pre-gate, frozen at decision time.

classes.failure_consequence: Patient-experience harm or material protocol deviation
Administrative or logistical; no safety or regulatory consequence

assignment.description: Two-factor logic from §3.0: model influence (axis) x decision consequence (axis), each scored high/medium/low, mapped to one of the four classes.
